messages:
morgan: Heads-up :wave: pushed API PR that changes response shape for /v2/generate — this is the thing blocking SDK + Console client bumps. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/421
hana: @morgan can you summarise the schema break? is it additive or breaking? :eyes:
morgan: It's mostly additive (adds metadata.tokens_used) but also renames `text` -> `content` for streaming messages. SDK will need to map both for a short window. Console needs the renamed prop for the new chat UI. Link to proto diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/compare/feature/stream-labels
devon: cc @samir I have a helm chart change ready that expects the new runtime flag `--stream-content` which toggles the rename on the server side. That needs runtime image 1.12+. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/helm-charts/pull/88
samir: I'll review the API PR today, but we should sequence merges: 1) runtime image release (1.12) 2) helm chart -> staging 3) API change behind feature flag 4) SDK/console client bump + canary 5) feature flag flip. Any objections?
jenna: sounds right. Can we gate SDK bump with a feature flag in the SDK too so older apps don't break? Might be faster to npm publish a minor that tolerates both fields.
morgan: yes SDK will ship a tolerant client in a minor; I can cut the release after API merges. Question: who can approve the runtime image release? @samir or infra?
samir: infra needs to run perf smoke. Ops-bot, can you run the smoke checklist on image tag `runtime:1.12.0-rc1`?
ops-bot: smoke-check queued for runtime:1.12.0-rc1 — tests: perf, kvcache, cgroup. ETA ~30m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
hana: tentative plan: aim to land runtime + helm in staging today, API tomorrow morning, SDK/console canary by midday. If smoke fails, we push by 24h. Who'll own the canary monitoring?
devon: I can own canary dashboards and alerting for the SDK/console rollout. Will create a short runbook in the PR with rollback steps.
jenna: I'll prep the SDK npm publish and tag instructions. @morgan pls ping when API is merged so I can start the canary.
morgan: will do. Also a small note: API PR includes a migration script that runs lazily, so feature-flag flip should be safe after canary for ~1 hour.
samir: ok I'm on API review now. If I approve we can kick infra for the image smoke.
devon: ping me when helm is merged, i'll queue staging deploy and add the canary route.
jenna: +1
ops-bot: smoke-check passed for runtime:1.12.0-rc1 — all green :tada:
morgan: great — merging API PR now, tagging for rollback steps in description.
samir: approved & merged.
jenna: SDK minor published as `@redwood/sdk@2.3.1` and npm tag `canary` set. Pinging devon for canary rollout.
devon: canary running, traffic routed to 10% for 2 hours. Monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/example-canary
hana: perfect. keep this thread for any rollout issues. If anything spikes, @pager we escalate.
